dct_title_s: Sea Surface Height Anomalies (L4), TOPEX/POSEIDON, JASON-1, OSTM/Jason-2, and Jason-3
dct_description_sm: The Sea Surface Height Anomalies (L4) layer show gridded Sea Surface Height Anomalies (SSHA) above a mean sea surface, on 1/6th degree grid every 5 days. It contains the fully corrected heights, but delayed 3 months.

The gridded data are derived from the SSHA data of TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason-1, Jason-2 and Jason-3 as reference data from the level 2 swath data found on the PO.DAAC website, plus ERS-1, ERS-2, Envisat, SARAL-AltiKa, CRyosat-2, depending on the date, from the RADS database. The gridding is done by the kriging method. The date given in the data is the center of the 5 day window.

A multi-day visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 1992-09-30 to 2019-01-22. Made from MEaSUREs Gridded Sea Surface Height Anomalies Version 1812 (SEA_SURFACE_HEIGHT_ALT_GRIDS_L4_2SATS_5DAY_6THDEG_V_JPL1812, version 1812, doi:10.5067/SLREF-CDRV2).
